get_speed_test_results.description: Return normalized Firewalla internet speed test results from the coordinator refresh path.

pause_rule.description: Pause one managed Firewalla rule. Provide either a duration or a resume time. If you provide neither, the rule stays paused until resumed.

rule_target.description: Enter the Rule ID shown on a Firewalla rule switch, or a selected rule ID from the runtime inventory for this Firewalla setup.

duration.description: Optional. How long to pause the rule, for example 30m, 4h, or 2d 4h 30m.
